body:
Someone puts the justification machine to work for the appetite.

They turn the exception into a philosophy: everyone does it, the rule is outdated, this case is special; the want has hired the ethics instead of consulting them.

With Jupiter square Lilith, people supply meaning and permission on demand to a hunger that wants both immediately.

When someone's appetite starts arguing like a principle, that is exactly when they need a second reader.

The case may even be right, but a conviction born this week deserves a date stamp before anyone trusts it.
